product_launches.description: Releaf Earth has launched Nigeria’s first operational industrial biochar production facility in Iwuru, Cross River State, converting palm kernel shells into biochar to improve soil and sequester carbon.

overview_description.description: Releaf is a supply chain technology firm that sources ingredients for African food factories. It aims to create climate-adaptive supply chains as Africa's population grows by 3 billion people. Releaf also provides extension services to smallholders, acts as a buyer of their products, and converts the raw material into factory-grade inputs for vegetable oil factories. Releaf uses digital technologies such as USSD and open banking, in addition to hardware, to work seamlessly with its network of over 2,000 smallholder farmers, who have supplied over 15 million kilograms of quality palm kernel nuts to food factories.

product.name: Biochar
product.description: A carbon-rich soil amendment produced from agricultural waste to improve soil fertility, water retention, and crop productivity while storing carbon in soil.

product.name: Kraken
product.description: A patented oil-palm de-shelling system designed for smallholder varieties and rural, off-grid operations, producing palm kernel shells for further processing.

product.name: SITE
product.description: A proprietary geospatial mapping tool for identifying suitable locations for biochar facilities based on feedstock availability and project economics.

product.name: Biochar Carbon Removal Projects
product.description: Development and operation of biochar production projects that convert agricultural waste into biochar while generating verifiable carbon dioxide removal.
